caption:
New York Fed numbers are out for Q3 📊

5.0% of all household debt is now in some stage of delinquency. That's up 0.3 points from the quarter before.

Credit card serious-delinquency flow actually eased a bit (6.87% vs 7.05% a year ago), while mortgages and auto ticked up.

Which bill feels the heaviest in your house right now?
